Show risk and model governance.
For Lakeshore Holdings, the risk and model governance picture shows one area of strength surrounded by a broad watch list that warrants leadership attention.
• Seven of eight controls are in watch status — close and consolidation, bank connectivity, contract renewal visibility, portfolio KPI freshness, and three business-unit feeds (Northline, Brightmark, Forge & Field) — meaning no single control is failing, but none has been validated to a governed, decision-ready standard.
• AI model-risk intake is the lone controlled item, backed by the AI Governance Registry and Databricks Innovation Workspace, which signals that the AI program has outpaced the operational infrastructure supporting it — a governance inversion worth noting.
• The concentration of watch items across Oracle Fusion, Kyriba Treasury, Ironclad CLM, and DealCloud means that finance, treasury, legal, and portfolio reporting all carry unresolved data-quality risk simultaneously.
Caveat: current business context is planning-grade; ownership and freshness require client validation before any control is closed.
| Risk / Control | Status | Systems |
|---|---|---|
| Close and consolidation | Watch | Oracle Fusion ERP, Workday |
| Bank connectivity | Watch | Kyriba Treasury, Oracle Fusion ERP |
| Contract renewal visibility | Watch | Ironclad CLM |
| Portfolio KPI freshness | Watch | Azure Data Lakehouse, DealCloud Portfolio CRM |
| AI model-risk intake | **Controlled** | AI Governance Registry, Databricks |
| Northline carrier feed quality | Watch | Northline TMS, Fleet Telematics |
| Brightmark brand-risk approval | Watch | Brightmark Marketing Automation, M365 Copilot |
| Forge & Field SKU-location quality | Watch | Forge & Field SAP S/4, Demand Planning |
**Branch:** Tower for prioritizing which watch items carry the highest business value at risk · Source for vendor and contract exposure behind Ironclad and Kyriba · Intelligence for tradeoffs on closing the governance inversion · Moves for sequencing the remediation across business units.
